text: To defeat evil, I must become a greater evil.
author: Lelouch Vi Britannia
reflection: The philosophy of strategic necessity and taking responsibility for the outcome.

text: A lesson without pain is meaningless. That's because no one can gain without sacrificing something.
author: Edward Elric

text: Ilmu adalah buruan dan tulisan adalah ikatannya. Ikatlah buruanmu dengan tali yang kuat.
author: Imam Syafi'i
reflection: Al-`Ilmu shaydun wa al-kitabatu qayduhu. It is a foolish thing to catch a deer but leave it untied in the open.

text: Jagalah ilmu dengan menulis (قَيِّدُوا العِلْمَ بِالكِتَابِ).
author: Rasulullah Shallallahu 'Alaihi wa Sallam
reflection: The divine command for documentation. This is the very essence of the Hybrid Scribe role.

text: Jika kamu tidak tahan lelahnya belajar, maka kamu harus tahan perihnya kebodohan.
author: Imam Syafi'i
reflection: A reminder for the Seeker Alchemist during long nights of research.

text: The purpose of science is to remove the hidden and reveal the manifest.
author: Al-Khawarizmi
reflection: Ungkap yang tersurat dan singkap yang tersirat.

text: Humankind cannot gain anything without first giving something in return. To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.
author: Alphonse Elric
reflection: The Law of Equivalent Exchange — the foundation of our Atelier.

author: Ali bin Abi Thalib
reflection: Science is like a wild animal, and writing is its leash.
